semantic.justification: AQF9AG ports actual SimpleTimeZone lazy rule construction with adopted DateTimeRule and owned Annual/Initial/Transition objects, original first-transition ordering, next/previous strict comparisons, borrowed rule output/capacity and cache behavior. Fragments operate on the one original owner. The next-transition cached first assignment continues into annual selection and can return false with changed output, per CALC-307; ID-only updates retain stale rule names, per CALC-309. Source cache reset order is preserved, with native leak finding CALC-308 documented rather than introducing a second cache. Single-thread synchronous initialization projects serialization; native mutex, allocation-failure, ABI and invalid lifetime states are uncertified. Unchanged ICU78.3 libraries/data match45789 combined annual/rule/transition/Calendar time cases; the probe and focused unit tests are limited to the stated operations. System/IANA/locale factories and full LibreOffice calendar/formatter/CSV integration remain incomplete.
